Mahindra Financial Services Limited''' ('''MMFSL''') is an Indian rural [[NBFC & MFI in India|non-banking financial company]] headquartered in [[Mumbai]].{{cite web|title=Mahindra & Mahindra Financial Services Overview|url=http://www.lse.co.in/LseAdmin/crpdf/Equity7034571287.pdf|publisher=LSE Securities|access-date=6 August 2013}} It is amongst the top tractor financers in India, with 1000+ offices across the country.{{cite web|title=You can buy non-banking finance companies stocks this time|date=25 February 2013|url=https://nsebsetechnicalanalysis.wordpress.com/2013/02/25/you-can-buy-non-banking-finance-companies-stocks-this-time/|publisher=NSE BSE Technical Analysis|access-date=6 August 2013}} Mahindra Finance started on 1 January 1991, as Maxi Motors Financial Services Limited.{{cite news|title=Mahindra & Mahindra Financial Services Ltd.|url=http://economictimes.indiatimes.com/mahindra-&-mahindra-financial-services-ltd/infocompanyhistory/companyid-3540.cms|access-date=6 August 2013|newspaper=The Economic Times}} They received the certificate of commencement of business on 19 February 1991. On 3 November 1992, Mahindra Finance changed their name to Mahindra & Mahindra Financial Services Limited.{{cite web|title=About Mahindra & Mahindra Financial Services Ltd l M&MFIN Company History|url=https://www.edelweiss.in/company/Mahindra-And-Mahindra-Financial-Services-Ltd/company-history/16795.html|publisher=Edelweiss|access-date=6 August 2013}} Mahindra Finance is registered with the [[Reserve Bank of India]] as an asset finance, deposit taking NBFC. In 1993, it commenced financing M&M utility vehicles, and in 1995 started its first branch outside Mumbai, in Jaipur. The company began financing non-M&M vehicles in 2002 and got into the business of financing commercial vehicles and construction equipment in 2009. In 2011, they had a joint venture with a Rabobank subsidiary for tractor financing in the US and consolidated the product portfolio by introducing small and medium enterprises (SME) financing.{{cite web|title=Mahindra & Mahindra Financial Services Ltd.|url=http://profit.ndtv.com/stock/mahindra-&-mahindra-financial-services-ltd_m&mfin/reports|publisher=NDTV Profit|access-date=14 August 2013}} ==Corporate affairs== As of November 2018, Ramesh Iyer is the Vice Chairman and President of Mahindra Financial Service Sector.{{cite web|title=Company Profile|url=http://in.reuters.com/finance/stocks/companyOfficers?symbol=MMFS.BO|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160304063400/http://in.reuters.com/finance/stocks/companyOfficers?symbol=MMFS.BO|url-status=dead|archive-date=4 March 2016|work=Reuters|access-date=14 August 2013}} == Products and services== ===Vehicle financing=== [[Vehicle financing]] includes auto and utility vehicles, tractors, cars, commercial vehicles and construction equipment. Pre-owned vehicle financing includes loans for used cars, multi-utility vehicles, tractors and commercial vehicles. ===SME financing=== Loans are offered for varied purposes like project finance, equipment finance and [[Working Capital Funds|working capital finance]].{{cite news|title=Mahindra Finance To Venture into Small Biz Lending|url=http://newswireblog.globeinfowire.com/mahindra-finance-to-venture-into-small-biz-lending/|access-date=6 August 2013|newspaper=Newswire|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20130816072423/http://newswireblog.globeinfowire.com/mahindra-finance-to-venture-into-small-biz-lending/|archive-date=16 August 2013|url-status=dead}} ===Housing finance=== MMFSL finances the rural and semi-urban population to build houses. ===Insurance broking=== The company offers insurance to retail customers as well as corporations through its subsidiary Mahindra Insurance Brokers Limited. ===Asset management company (mutual fund)=== Launched in June 2016, the company offers mutual fund products, whose NAV is around ₹1000. The MAMC started with an AUM of ₹120 crore. ===Mutual fund distribution=== MMFSL advises clients on investing money under the brand Mahindra Finance Finsmart{{cite news|title=Mahindra Finance to venture into small business lending|url=https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/industry-and-economy/banking/mahindra-finance-to-venture-into-small-business-lending/article3361376.ece|access-date=6 August 2013|newspaper=Business Line|date=27 April 2013}} ==Subsidiaries== ===Mahindra Mutual Fund=== Mahindra Asset Management Company Private Limited is a wholly owned subsidiary of Mahindra and Mahindra Financial Services Limited (MMFSL). Mahindra AMC Pvt Ltd is the Investment Manager for Mahindra Mutual Fund. It started its operation in July 2016, with an AUM of ₹120 crore. Currently, its NAV is floating around ₹1000. Mahindra Mutual Fund endeavors to offer a variety of mutual fund schemes pan India, with special focus in rural and semi-urban areas.{{Cite web |url=http://www.financialexpress.com/article/markets/indian-markets/sebi-grants-licence-to-mahindra-mutual-fund/207947/ |title=SEBI Grants Licence to Mahindra Mutual Fund | the Financial Express |access-date=1 April 2016 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160318092431/http://www.financialexpress.com/article/markets/indian-markets/sebi-grants-licence-to-mahindra-mutual-fund/207947/ |archive-date=18 March 2016 |url-status=dead }} ===Mahindra Insurance Brokers Limited=== In FY 2012–13, the insurance broking subsidiary, Mahindra Insurance Brokers Limited (MIBL) crossed the 8,00,000 mark in terms of the policies served. The company's total policies, at the end of 2012–13, stood at 8,39,408 for both life and non-life retail business lines. It reached a total of ₹600 crore gross premium. The income increased by 85 per cent from ₹46.6 crore in 2011–12 to ₹86.3 crore in 2012–13. During the year, MIBL entered into a strategic partnership with [[LeapFrog Investments]], world's largest investor in insurance for the underserved.{{cite news|title=Mahindra & Mahindra Group takes a giant stride with LeapFrog deal|url=http://articles.economictimes.indiatimes.com/2012-09-21/news/34002527_1_tech-mahindra-anand-mahindra-rural-markets|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120922130331/http://articles.economictimes.indiatimes.com/2012-09-21/news/34002527_1_tech-mahindra-anand-mahindra-rural-markets|url-status=dead|archive-date=22 September 2012|access-date=6 August 2013|newspaper=The Economic Times|date=21 September 2012}} Through its subsidiary company, Inclusion Resources Private Limited, LeapFrog invested ₹80.4 crore for a 15% shareholding in MIBL. PayBima is the digital arm of Mahindra Insurance Brokers Ltd and was launched to help customers compare and buy insurance policies online through their website.{{Cite news|title=Mahindra Insurance Brokers launches digital insurance portal PayBima|url=https://www.moneycontrol.com/news/business/companies/exclusive-mahindra-insurance-brokers-launches-digital-insurance-portal-paybima-5813561.html}} ===Mahindra Rural Housing Finance Limited=== In FY 2012–13, Mahindra Rural Housing Finance Limited (MRHFL) disbursed loans aggregating to ₹432.9 crore, up from ₹266.8 crore in the previous year. The profit after tax for 2012-13 stood at ₹222.3 crore against ₹11.9 crore in the previous year. The outstanding loan portfolio, as on 31 March 2013, stood at ₹879.5 crore.{{cite web|title=Company Overview of Mahindra Rural Housing Finance Ltd.|url=http://investing.businessweek.com/research/stocks/private/snapshot.asp?privcapid=31287340|archive-url=https://archive.today/20130806145236/http://investing.businessweek.com/research/stocks/private/snapshot.asp?privcapid=31287340|url-status=dead|archive-date=6 August 2013|work=Bloomberg Businessweek|access-date=6 August 2013}} ===Mahindra Business and Consulting Services Private Limited=== Mahindra Finance's wholly owned subsidiary, Mahindra Business & Consulting Services Private Limited (MBCSPL), provides staffing services primarily to Mahindra Finance. It also serves the subsidiaries (MIBL and MRHFL) and the parent company (Mahindra & Mahindra Limited). During the year, MBCSPL deputed 8,098 employees to these companies. The profit after tax increased from ₹7.1 lakh in 2011–12 to ₹173.8 lakh in 2012–13.{{cite web|title=Company Overview of Mahindra Business & Consulting Services Private Limited|url=http://investing.businessweek.com/research/stocks/private/snapshot.asp?privcapId=109718600|archive-url=https://archive.today/20130806145215/http://investing.businessweek.com/research/stocks/private/snapshot.asp?privcapId=109718600|url-status=dead|archive-date=6 August 2013|work=Bloomberg Businessweek|access-date=6 August 2013}} ==References== {{reflist}} {{Mahindra Group}} {{Nifty 200 companies}} {{DEFAULTSORT:Mahindra and Mahindra Financial Services Limited}} [[Category:Financial services companies of India]] [[Category:Mahindra Group]] [[Category:Financial services companies based in Mumbai]] [[Category:Financial services companies established in 1991]] [[Category:Indian companies established in 1991]] [[Category:1991 establishments in Maharashtra]] [[Category:Companies listed on the National Stock Exchange of India]] [[Category:Companies listed on the Bombay Stock Exchange]] [[Category:Asset management companies]]

Mahindra & Mahindra Financial Services Limited (MMFSL) is an Indian rural non-banking financial company headquartered in Mumbai. It is amongst the top tractor financers in India, with 1000+ offices across the country.
Mahindra Finance started on 1 January 1991, as Maxi Motors Financial Services Limited. They received the certificate of commencement of business on 19 February 1991. On 3 November 1992, Mahindra Finance changed their name to Mahindra & Mahindra Financial Services Limited. Mahindra Finance is registered with the Reserve Bank of India as an asset finance, deposit taking NBFC.
In 1993, it commenced financing M&M utility vehicles, and in 1995 started its first branch outside Mumbai, in Jaipur. The company began financing non-M&M vehicles in 2002 and got into the business of financing commercial vehicles and construction equipment in 2009. In 2011, they had a joint venture with a Rabobank subsidiary for tractor financing in the US and consolidated the product portfolio by introducing small and medium enterprises (SME) financing.
